collate_batch_tensors: create a function that stacks a batch of torch tensors into a single tensor with batch dimension
collate_numpy_arrays: convert a batch of numpy arrays into torch tensors using the default collate function
collate_dict_batch: recursively collate a batch of dictionaries into a single dictionary with stacked tensor values
collate2d_images: collate a batch of 2D image samples with variable sizes into padded tensors with boolean masks
collate2d_split_batch: split and collate a batch of image samples into sub-batches for multiple gradient update iterations
